# DBM Associates: Design, Build & Manage

> DBM Associate (Pvt) Ltd (Reg. No. P.V.00227523) is an architectural and building consultancy in Pannipitiya, Sri Lanka. It designs warehouses, industrial buildings, offices, commercial buildings and homes, and prepares building approvals with the UDA and local authorities.

- Address: No. 60/1, Digana Road, Palanwatta, Pannipitiya, Sri Lanka
- Phone: +94 74 060 0780, +94 70 403 5095
- Areas served: Pannipitiya, Maharagama, Kottawa, Homagama, Nugegoda, Piliyandala, Colombo and all of Sri Lanka
- Services: architectural design, building approvals (UDA / local authority), structural and MEP coordination, project supervision, landscape design
- Process: six staged design phases (engagement, schematic design, design development, development approval, working drawings, landscape design), each billed separately
